title: A data item has stable identity across files
description:
As a corpus reviewer, I want a data item identity that can span files, so that three email fields can be one item or three by declaration, not by line number.

Feature: data item identity

  Scenario: Same item two files
    Given mentions of email on user.ts line 8 and customer.ts line 12
    And they declare the same data item identity
    When I score the data-item layer
    Then there is one data item
    And both mentions count as evidence

  Scenario: Distinct items
    Given those same two mentions
    And they declare different data item identities
    When I score the data-item layer
    Then there are two data items
